articles.headline: Wemby says Spurs losing in Finals 'biggest lesson of my life'
articles.description: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama said he's "not running away" from the pain of losing to the Knicks in the NBA Finals, calling the experience "the biggest learning moment" of his life.

images.name: Victor Wembanyama [600x400]
images.caption: Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs lost 4-1 in the NBA Finals despite holding double-digit leads in all five games.
